resolution.question: Three families on the same cul-de-sac are trying to set up a school-run carpool. Will they agree a weekly driving rota before term starts on Monday morning?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that all three families have agreed on a specific weekly driving rota before 2026-09-07T00:00:00+12:00 (Monday morning). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
